details.description: Warm mid-grey asphalt with fine pale and dark aggregate.
A broad long darker repair strip runs along the right lane.
Irregular rectangular tar-sealed repairs cross the near left lane and centre.
A rounded dark patched pothole is visible toward the far end of the left lane.
Four short chalky white centre dashes have worn broken margins.
Pale scuffs and rubbed white remnants surround portions of the markings.
Warm cream sidewalk bands contain transverse slab joints and subtle mineral speckle.
Chipped grey kerb margins and dark joint staining run beside the road.
One rust-brown lattice grate sits near the middle left kerb with a vertical inlet above it.
Orange-brown staining spreads into the sidewalk around the drain.
The reference has thick vertical sides and raised kerbs; the explicit native contract instead requires one flat quad.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: Preserve one8m quad at y=0,2triangles,1draw/material/geometry and the1.25/5.5/1.25m band profile.
Match the visible reference top surfaces: warm asphalt, identifiable repair layout, four worn centre dashes, cream slab bands and the left rusted lattice drain.
Use independent normal and roughness responses for asphalt, concrete, paint and rust; no raised kerbs or slab walls.
Inspect reference, registered diagnostic, normal-disabled/grazing views and aligned0/180 neighboring ends.
All checks and installed/export parity pass, and whole-asset visual quality exceeds95.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

reviewHistory.summary: Whole-asset visual estimate72/100 within the explicit flat-quad contract. Geometry and band dimensions are correct, but reference-specific long patches, tar repairs, four worn dashes and left lattice drain are replaced by generic cracks, clean paint and a simplified right-side grate. Independent normals contain a broad directional bias: aligned0/180 neighboring tiles alternate very dark and light under grazing light. Rebuild the visible-top material layout from the registered original plate, correct normal bias, distinguish material roughness and repair the6.25cm collider lift. All baseline deterministic gates ran before this visual review.

Reconstruct end bands with two-dimensional texture samples, replace the contaminated normal grain with an independent fine statistical field, and retain the authored repair/grate response.
